sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Do you feel the world is broken?
We do.
Do you feel the shadows deepen?
We do.
But all the dark won't stop the light from getting through.
Do you wish you could see it all made new?
We do.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Is all creation groaning?
It is.
Is a new creation coming?
It is.
Is the glory of the Lord the light within our midst?
It is.
Is it good that we remind ourselves of this?
It is.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Is anyone worthy? Is anyone whole?
Is anyone able to break the seal and open the scroll?
The Lion of Judah, who conquered the grave —
David's Root, the Lamb who died to ransom the slave.

sections.label: REFRAIN
pairs: Is He worthy? Is He worthy?
Of all blessing, and honor, and glory?
Is He worthy of this?

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Does the Father truly love us?
He does.
Does the Spirit move among us?
He does.
Does Jesus our Messiah hold forever those He loves?
He does.
Does our God intend to dwell again with us?
He does.

sections.label: POST-CHORUS
pairs: From every people and tribe,
Every nation and tongue —
He has made us a kingdom and priests to God,
To reign with the Son.

sections.label: FINAL DECLARATION
pairs: Is He worthy? Is He worthy?
He is worthy. He is worthy.
sections.finale: HE IS WORTHY OF IT ALL.
